reviews.text: Tom is a fantastic guy! Very prompt in giving quotes, very fast in getting the job done. Very professional and serious with what he does. Highly recommended!
Tom did a great job in a tight space with a large poplar tree near a power line. Professional service, great equipment and great to deal with.
He replied promptly to my email, was polite and was able to do the work the day after he quoted, which was great.
No job too big or too small. Tom, Joe and Evan worked hard and got the job done, good pricing and well organised.
